description: Small representative prompt suite for Pre-mode/pCodex tuning and benchmark-assisted strategy comparison.

prompts.name: cli_compile_path
prompts.prompt: Fix a failing compile command without changing plugin or MCP behavior.

prompts.name: test_fix_narrow
prompts.prompt: Fix the failing test while keeping the implementation scope minimal.

prompts.name: docs_only_update
prompts.prompt: Update the documentation for the public source install path without changing runtime behavior.

prompts.name: config_safe_change
prompts.prompt: Adjust repository configuration safely without touching generated runtime outputs.

prompts.name: scope_guarded_patch
prompts.prompt: Make a narrow patch and do not modify .premode/out, .premode/audit, .premode/metrics, or generated artifacts.
